pr_body:

issue_context.title: Missing "use_time" attribute for new Xiaomi Humidifier integration
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When Home Assistant made a change in Xiaomi Humidifier support
changing from fan.X type to humidifier.X type
there is missing one attribute from old integration: "use_time"

Can you please fix by adding this attribute again to new integration?

Thank you!

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.9.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.7.X

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

Xiaomi Miio
